# deed Provider

Manages a [Deed](https://github.com/aurimasniekis/go-deed) installation — a declarative infrastructure catalog — through its versioned API (`/api/v1`): projects, custom kinds and relationship types, entities and the relationships between them.

Every entity and relationship is written as a **declaration through one Deed source** (`terraform` by default). Terraform state holds only that declaration, never the merged view, so data contributed by other sources (imports, runtime observations, UI annotations) never causes a diff and survives `terraform destroy`.

Authenticate with a user API token (`deed_at_…`). Tokens are created by a signed-in user (the account page of the Deed web UI, or `POST /api/v1/me/tokens` from an interactive session with a recent sign-in) and act with at most that user's roles. A token with the installation `admin` role can manage everything; a token capped at a project `editor` role can manage entities and relationships in that project only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    deed = {
      source = "aurimasniekis/deed"
    }
  }
}

# The endpoint and token can also come from DEED_ENDPOINT and DEED_TOKEN.
provider "deed" {
  endpoint = "https://deed.example.com"
  token    = var.deed_token # a user API token (deed_at_…) created by a signed-in user

  # Optional: the Deed source every entity and relationship is declared through (default "terraform", or DEED_SOURCE).
  # source_name = "terraform"

  # Optional: trust a private CA in addition to the system roots (or DEED_CA_FILE).
  # ca_file = "/etc/ssl/private-ca.pem"
}

variable "deed_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ca_file` (String) Path to a PEM file with additional CA certificates to trust (private PKI). May also be set with `DEED_CA_FILE`.
- `endpoint` (String) Public URL of the Deed installation, for example `https://deed.example.com`. May also be set with the `DEED_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `source_name` (String) Name of the Deed source every entity and relationship is declared through. Defaults to `terraform` (a system source of every project); may also be set with `DEED_SOURCE`. Use a dedicated manual source to run several independent Terraform configurations against the same entities. (Terraform reserves the argument name `source` in provider blocks, hence `source_name`.)
- `token` (String, Sensitive) User API token (`deed_at_` followed by 43 base62 characters). May also be set with the `DEED_TOKEN` environment variable. Managing projects, kinds and relationship types needs a token with the installation `admin` role; entities and relationships need the project `editor` role.
